game.name: Superliminal
game.rules:
## Submissions

All submissions must include a **video** (with audible **game sound**) of the full run.

The auto-save icon in the bottom right must be visible in the recording.

Each run can only be submitted to a single category (e.g. you cannot submit a Glitchless run to Any%).

When submitting a run, you should specify which version you were playing on. You can find the version number in the bottom left of the game's *Options* menu.

Be aware that some videos are not stored permanently (i.e., Twitch VODs). Runs using volatile videos are subject to rejection.

## Timing

You must enable the **in-game speedrun timer** to time your runs. Alternatively, if you play on PC, you can use **LiveSplit**.

If you use LiveSplit, you **must enable the auto-splitter** and compare against game time. If you start/stop/pause LiveSplit manually, your submission will be rejected.

If neither the in-game timer nor LiveSplit is visible in your video, your submission will be rejected.

## General rules

You must start the run via the level select screen or by clicking "New Game". You are not allowed to play on Extra Mode.

Please refrain from **pausing the game** during your runs, except when required (e.g. resetting to checkpoint). If you pause the game for too long and for no particular reason, your submission might be rejected.

Your run must be performed **as if you started from a clean save file**. You are not allowed to take advantage of anything that is unlocked after having already played the game, unless explicitly allowed by the category rules.

The use of 3rd party/external tools to assist the run is banned. If you're unsure, please ask.

categories.name: Jumpless
categories.rules: You cannot jump. You cannot go out of bounds. You cannot use portal glitches.

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
You must finish the game without using any glitch.

Banned glitches include the following ones:

- Any kind of launch
- Going out of bounds
- Warps (using objects to instantly teleport far away)
- Taking objects through object barriers
- Using the queen in Labyrinth to press the plate for a split second
- Clicking the light switch in Whitespace while grabbing an object **at the same time**

If you accidentally trigger a glitch which **saves time** in your run, you must reset to the previous checkpoint, or your run will be rejected.

categories.name: All Collectables
categories.rules:
All collectables shown in level select must be gathered.
The video must include footage of collectables having been reset before starting the run and all levels must be shown in level select to prove everything was collected after the run.
The run must be one continuous run.
Warps are not allowed.

Doing a playthrough before the reset to open Jungles' Bistro is allowed.

categories.name: All Achievements
categories.rules:
All in-game achievements must be collected. This does not include workshop achievements.

Submission must include footage of the runner clearing the achievements before the run begins. All Achievements must be shown as collected at the end of the run.

Timing starts on walking through the first door in induction.

Timing ends when the final achievement has been collected.

All glitches except for Warps are allowed.
